# Kerui Refractory

> > A leading Chinese refractory materials supplier offering high-quality bricks and castables for industrial furnaces and kilns since 2004.

Kerui Refractory specializes in manufacturing and supplying refractory products including high alumina, mullite, magnesia, and dolomite bricks for steel, cement, and other high-temperature industrial applications. The company provides comprehensive product catalogs, technical guidance, and direct inquiry services for industrial customers worldwide.
